response.rationale: All nine cited items are positive and none is negative, including several T3-T4 studies (Gooskens 2007 and 2018, Kürschner 2008, Dijkstra 2010, Lemhöfer 2004) that link lexical, cognate or orthographic proximity to intelligibility or recognition, though phonetic distance is sometimes the stronger predictor for spoken language and the talk:18 item largely restates Klein 2000 and Gooskens 2007, so it is not independent.
